<documents>
<document id="security-password-reset">
ResettingˆyourˆpasswordˆIfˆyouˆforgotˆyourˆpassword,ˆyouˆcanˆresetˆitˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ##ˆResetˆyourˆpasswordˆ1.ˆTapˆForgotˆpasswordˆonˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆemailˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆaˆresetˆlink.ˆ3.ˆOpenˆtheˆlinkˆonˆtheˆsameˆphone,ˆconfirmˆtheˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆtextˆyou,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆnewˆpassword.ˆTheˆlinkˆexpiresˆafterˆanˆhour.ˆIfˆitˆhasˆexpired,ˆstartˆagain.ˆ##ˆDidn'tˆgetˆtheˆemail?ˆCheckˆspamˆandˆmakeˆsureˆyouˆenteredˆtheˆemailˆyouˆsignedˆupˆwith.ˆIfˆyouˆnoˆlongerˆhaveˆaccessˆtoˆthatˆemail,ˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆForˆyourˆsecurity,ˆchangingˆtheˆemailˆonˆanˆaccountˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆinˆtoˆneedsˆextraˆchecks.ˆ##ˆAfterˆaˆresetˆOtherˆdevicesˆareˆsignedˆout.ˆTheˆfirstˆtimeˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500ˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆIfˆyouˆdidn'tˆaskˆforˆaˆresetˆemail,ˆsomeoneˆmayˆhaveˆtypedˆyourˆemailˆbyˆmistake.ˆIfˆyouˆalsoˆseeˆaˆsign-inˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize,ˆseeˆ"Ifˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccount".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-never-ask">
Whatˆwe'llˆneverˆaskˆyouˆScammersˆoftenˆpretendˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbank.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆTallowbrookˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆfor,ˆbyˆphone,ˆtext,ˆemail,ˆchatˆorˆsocialˆmedia.ˆ##ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆforˆ-ˆYourˆfullˆcardˆnumberˆorˆsecurityˆcodeˆ-ˆYourˆPINˆ-ˆYourˆpasswordˆorˆpasscodeˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆsentˆyouˆ-ˆRemoteˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆphoneˆorˆcomputerˆ-ˆToˆmoveˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆ"safeˆaccount"ˆtoˆprotectˆitˆ-ˆToˆbuyˆgiftˆcardsˆorˆsendˆcryptocurrencyˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆmightˆaskˆInˆtheˆapp,ˆsupportˆmayˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆrecentˆtransactionsˆorˆyourˆaddress.ˆThat'sˆinˆyourˆsigned-inˆsession,ˆwhereˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasksˆStop,ˆhangˆupˆorˆcloseˆtheˆchat.ˆOpenˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆyourselfˆandˆmessageˆus.ˆDon'tˆcallˆaˆnumberˆorˆtapˆaˆlinkˆtheˆpersonˆgaveˆyou.ˆOurˆrealˆphoneˆnumberˆisˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆHelp.ˆIfˆyouˆalreadyˆsharedˆaˆcodeˆorˆpassword,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆrightˆawayˆandˆmessageˆusˆsoˆweˆcanˆsecureˆyourˆaccount.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-account-takeover">
IfˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccountˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆsomeoneˆelseˆhasˆsignedˆinˆtoˆyourˆaccount,ˆactˆfast.ˆ##ˆSignsˆtoˆlookˆforˆ-ˆAˆpasswordˆchangeˆorˆnew-deviceˆsign-inˆyouˆdidn'tˆmakeˆ-ˆYourˆemailˆaddressˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆchangedˆwithoutˆyouˆ-ˆTransfersˆorˆBrookPayˆpaymentsˆyouˆdidn'tˆsendˆ-ˆYou'reˆsuddenlyˆsignedˆoutˆandˆcan'tˆsignˆbackˆinˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆIfˆyouˆcanˆstillˆsignˆin,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆfreezeˆyourˆcards.ˆ2.ˆMessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆapp,ˆorˆcallˆusˆifˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆin.ˆ##ˆWhatˆwe'llˆdoˆSupportˆwillˆfreezeˆyourˆcardsˆandˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆFraudˆteam,ˆwhoˆhandleˆaccountˆtakeovers.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆcontactsˆyouˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆusuallyˆmuchˆfaster.ˆTheyˆmayˆsignˆoutˆeveryˆdevice,ˆresetˆyourˆcredentialsˆandˆreviewˆrecentˆactivityˆwithˆyou.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆreverseˆtransfersˆorˆchangeˆyourˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆduringˆaˆtakeoverˆinvestigation.ˆTheˆFraudˆteamˆdoesˆthatˆonceˆthey'veˆconfirmedˆwhoˆyouˆare.ˆ##ˆAfterwardˆCheckˆyourˆemailˆaccount'sˆsecurityˆtoo.ˆManyˆtakeoversˆstartˆwithˆaˆcompromisedˆemail.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
